_comment: Hand-written Vietnamese for the strings HikaShop has no word for. Merged over the ones taken
from HikaShop's own vi-VN file by tools/build-locales.mjs, so regenerating keeps these.
Vietnamese counts in one form: the noun does not change after a numeral, so 5 biến thể is
right and there is nothing for a second plural form to say.
Polite address (quý khách is for customers; the operator is addressed plainly).
